quote: Simple groups of square order and an interesting sequence of primes
posed_by: Morris Newman, Daniel Shanks, Hugh C. Williams
note: NSW primes were introduced in the 1980 publication in Acta Arithmetica (Volume 38, pages 129-140), though Wikipedia's text states 1981. The original paper was not explicitly posing a conjecture but rather introduced the sequence during study of finite simple groups with square order.
